name: Shimeng
source:
The protagonist's sister and guardian, a genius honor student at Hucheng's top girls' high school.
Skilled in cooking and fashion. Although she often bickers with him, she always takes care of him.
Since "that time," she has vowed to become strong and excellent enough to protect him, who was once deeply hurt.

(*This character will inherit the protagonist's surname customized by player)

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021350]Steam[/url]]
